title: No insulin delivery possible when the loop is suspended on AAPS 3.4.0.0
symptom: On AAPS 3.4.0.0 with Omnipod Dash, when the loop is suspended, it is not possible to bolus insulin anymore. Additionally, on Nightscout this period shows as 'OTHER' instead of 'SUSPENDED'.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. One commenter suggests it is a defect, and another notes that the behavior started after updating to 3.4.0.0, but no specific cause is identified.
fix: The thread does not state a resolution. One user mentions that with slight code modifications it works, but no specific fix is provided.
evidence_quote: On AAPS 3.4.0.0 when the loop is suspended, it is not possible to bolus insulin anymore
